ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New business, Lead and later stages need Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_business", CASE(StageName, "Lead", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Brief and scope", 3, "Proposal sent (New business)", 4, "Pitch or review", 5, "Negotiation (New business)", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 1, ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Next step date before moving to Lead.
